# Security and Privacy Checklist: Local YouTube Audio Acquisition

**Purpose**: Review whether the v0.1 requirements adequately protect local media and credentials
**Created**: 2026-09-16
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `$speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are local-only handling requirements defined for media, transcripts, browser sessions, and credentials? [Completeness, Spec §FR-006]
- [x] CHK002 Are requirements defined for both anonymous acquisition and browser-session recovery paths? [Coverage, Spec §US2]
- [x] CHK003 Are failure requirements specified for unavailable downloader, blocked access, and unreadable browser sessions? [Coverage, Spec §FR-008]

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK004 Is “best available audio” defined sufficiently for the v0.1 acceptance boundary? [Clarity, Spec §FR-003]
- [x] CHK005 Is the boundary between one-video handling and excluded playlist batch processing explicit? [Clarity, Spec §FR-002]
- [x] CHK006 Are the conditions for using the local browser-session fallback clear and explicit? [Clarity, Spec §FR-005]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [x] CHK007 Can successful acquisition be objectively measured by the stated artifact and single-video outcomes? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002]
- [x] CHK008 Can privacy compliance be objectively assessed without requiring credential disclosure? [Measurability, Spec §SC-003]
- [x] CHK009 Are deterministic CI boundaries clearly separated from unstable live-service verification? [Consistency, Spec §SC-005]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [x] CHK010 Are malformed URLs, missing video IDs, and unsupported hosts covered as distinct validation concerns? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK011 Is the behavior defined when the output directory is absent or cannot be used? [Gap, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK012 Is the required human authorization boundary for browser or operating-system access explicit? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `$speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `$speckit-specify` and `$speckit-clarify`
- Add comments or findings inline
- Link to relevant resources or documentation
- Items are numbered sequentially for easy reference
